description: Lists the glaze recipes saved in your Glazecalc account, newest first, optionally only those whose title or a material matches a search, or whose stated firing includes a cone or names an atmosphere or process ("which of my glazes fire at cone 10 reduction?"). Each lists its stated firing; a recipe with none has not stated one.

atmosphere.description: Only recipes stated for this atmosphere.

cone.description: Only recipes whose stated firing includes this cone ("6", "06", "5.5", SK "6a"), or for scale "temperature" this °C. A range matches any cone inside it; recipes tested at it come first. Recipes stated in another scale match approximately: Orton and SK by the Kyoto institute’s same-kiln table (SK 7 to 14 against Orton 4 to 12; other cones match their own scale only), a temperature when the cone bends within 15 °C of it (Orton by its older chart for large cones at 150 °C an hour, which has figures to cone 15).

limit.description: How many to return, 25 by default.

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

process.description: Only recipes stated for this firing process.

scale.description: The scale the cone is in: Orton (the default), SK (JIS R 8101) or a temperature in °C.

name: list_recipes
title: List my recipes
